current.text: Sandro Mamukelashvili, who played a lot of backup center in Toronto, is gone.
Toronto's projected starters are Quickley, Barrett, Leonard, Barnes and Poeltl. Poeltl is the only seven-footer on the roster.
Experts do not expect him to start over Jakob Poeltl. They expect him to close games as the center in a small, switchable closing five with Quickley, Barrett, Leonard and Barnes.
Experts expect about 25 to 27 minutes a game, three to four more than last season, helped by Mamukelashvili's exit.
His usage is projected to rise from 15% to about 18%. He should have the ball more and score more. One expert predicts a top-three Sixth Man of the Year finish.
He has no thumb injury now and is expected to play a full season.
Experts see him as about a top 100 player as a baseline, with top 70 to top 80 upside if he reaches 30 minutes. One expert says he could average 12 points, 7 rebounds and 1.5 blocks.
Experts call him a good upside flyer worth a late pick even for managers who already have Poeltl. One would consider drafting him ahead of Poeltl.
He is a buzzy name in drafts now and went for 9 USD in an expert auction mock.
Toronto is not deep beyond a solid top seven and is projected to win about 52 games.

durable.text: He is 6'7 and plays center. Toronto's rebounding and rim protection held steady or improved with him at center.
His three-point shot is not reliable yet. It was fine on low volume but is a longer-term project, so he makes almost no threes and fits punt 3PM builds.
He missed a lot of time in 2025-26 and played through a thumb injury that season.

note: Yahoo ranks him 102 with a 5 USD value, and ESPN ranks him 171 with a value of 0 USD. Both sites have average costs near 1 USD. In a 144-player draft he is a late flyer. Expect to pay about 2 to 5 USD, since he is getting buzz and went for 9 USD in an expert mock. His profile fits punt 3PM teams: efficient shooting (about 59% FG on low volume), solid steals and blocks, and low turnovers. His 66% FT is a small hit. Early in the season, check whether he really plays 25 or more minutes and closes games behind Poeltl. At 30 minutes the experts see top 70 to 80 value.
